about: The battle's form of the roster: RULES and FIGHTERS exactly as r3/battle/tools/build-data.mjs writes them into engine/src/roster.gen.ts from roster.json, with r3/battle/engine/balance.overrides.json applied (56 design numbers, each "was" checked) and no text overrides: copy/overrides.json is the words file, and each of its "was" is this text. Generated by roster/tools/build-battle.mjs; never edit by hand.

RULES.ringRule: An attack is 1.5x against the next discipline on the ring and 0.67x against the previous one; every other pairing is 1x. Dual disciplines multiply.
RULES.costRule: stat = floor + span x percentile rank of one fact within the roster (ties share the mean rank). HP 270 + 70 x rank(commits at the pinned SHA, on the card's own paths where it shares a repository); ATK 95 + 35 x rank(GitHub stars on the date its receipt gives); DEF 95 + 35 x rank(check files matching the proof glob at the pinned SHA); SPD 95 + 35 x rank(commits per active day). Cost from the stat total (HP / 2.5 + ATK + DEF + SPD): 500 or more costs 4, 475 to 499 costs 3, 445 to 474 costs 2, below 445 costs 1; a team of three spends at most 7.
